Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using the InvestorHub platform and its services.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to InvestorHub. By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use our services.

accountRegistration.title: 2. Account Registration
accountRegistration.content: You may need to create an account to access certain services. You are responsible for providing accurate information and keeping your account details secure.

investmentTrading.title: 3. Investment & Trading
investmentTrading.content: Investment and trading activities involve risk. Information shown on the platform is provided for general information and does not guarantee profits or financial results.

paymentsWithdrawals.title: 4. Payments & Withdrawals
paymentsWithdrawals.content: You are responsible for providing accurate payment and withdrawal information. Processing times and requirements may vary depending on the service used.

userResponsibilities.title: 5. User Responsibilities
userResponsibilities.content: You agree to use the platform lawfully and responsibly. You must not interfere with the platform, access another user's account, or use the service for fraudulent or unauthorized activities.

limitationOfLiability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.content: To the extent permitted by applicable law, InvestorHub is not responsible for losses caused by market conditions, technical interruptions, or circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

changesToTerms.title: 7. Changes to These Terms
changesToTerms.content: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Changes become effective when posted on this page. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This section explains how InvestorHub may collect, use, and protect information provided through the platform.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We may collect information you provide when creating an account, contacting us, or using our services. This may include your name, contact information, account details, and other information needed to provide our services.

howWeUseInformation.title: 2. How We Use Information
howWeUseInformation.content: Information may be used to provide and improve our services, communicate with users, protect accounts, process requests, and meet applicable legal or operational requirements.

informationProtection.title: 3. Information Protection
informationProtection.content: We use reasonable measures to protect information collected through the platform. However, no electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to maintain sessions, improve functionality, and understand how users interact with the platform.

thirdPartyServices.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.content: The platform may use third-party services for payments, authentication, analytics, hosting, or other features. These services may process information under their own privacy policies.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights
yourRights.content: Depending on applicable laws, you may have rights regarding the information we hold about you, including requesting access, correction, or deletion of certain information.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about these Terms & Conditions or this Privacy Policy, please contact our support team.
